suggested_rewrite: Define specific risk mitigation requirements and metrics
Quantify protection requirements with measurable standards
Specify technical conditions where requirements apply/don't apply

non_compliant_sections.requirement: Regular testing and evaluation of security measures
non_compliant_sections.issue: Policy lacks explicit requirements for regular assessment and evaluation of technical and organizational security measures

non_compliant_sections.requirement: Ability to restore data availability after incidents
non_compliant_sections.issue: No clear procedures for ensuring timely restoration of data access after physical/technical incidents
While vulnerability scanning is required, lacks comprehensive security testing requirements
Encryption requirements present but pseudonymization not explicitly addressed

recommended_modifications: Add explicit requirements for regular testing and evaluation of all security measures
Include detailed procedures for data restoration and business continuity after incidents
Implement comprehensive security testing requirements beyond vulnerability scanning
Add requirements for data pseudonymization where appropriate
Strengthen requirements around incident response and recovery procedures

redundant_sections: Authentication and authorization requirements - overlaps with Policy 5.8
Data retention requirements - overlaps with Policy 4.7
Data breach notification procedures - overlaps with Policy 5.4.2
integration_suggestions: Consolidate authentication requirements with Policy 5.8 and reference rather than duplicate
Create unified data classification framework across all related policies
Merge data retention requirements into Policy 4.7 and reference from this policy
Standardize security incident reporting procedures across policies 5.4.2 and 5.10
Develop common baseline security controls that apply across all data classifications

burden.efficiency_gain: Significant reduction in data security incidents and compliance violations through standardized controls and clear responsibilities
streamlining_opportunities: Implement automated compliance monitoring and reporting tools
Create self-service portal for security requirements by data classification
Standardize vulnerability scanning and patch management across units
Automate account access reviews and privilege management

implementation_barriers: Extensive technical requirements across different device types
Need for regular updates to security controls
predictive_optimization: Develop standardized security baselines across campuses
Improve security exception tracking and renewal processes
